pr_title: Fix bug with WAL watcher and Live Reader metrics usage.
pr_body:
I noticed then when looking into the pending samples issue again.

Calling NewXMetrics when creating a Watcher or LiveReader results in a
registration error, which we're ignoring, and as a result other than the
first Watcher/Reader created, we had no metrics for either. So we would
only have metrics like Watcher Records Read for the first remote write
config in a users config file.

cc @roidelapluie it would be good to get this in the 2.17 release if possible

Signed-off-by: Callum Styan <callumstyan@gmail.com>
pr_comments: Can you please provide a one-liner for changelog? e.g. the name of the metric(s) fixed.

Mirroring what I said in IRC, the bug would have affected at least all these metrics: https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/blob/master/tsdb/wal/watcher.go#L87-L135

For all but the first remote write in the configuration file.
Closing to go to 2.17 directly, I can't change branches.

There are comments here: https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/7002

Can you address them and rebase the PR to release-2.17? I hope we can fix #6997 in a 2.17.1, together with this bug.

To reply to the comments from the other pr:

https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/7002#pullrequestreview-376882433 @beorn7 definitely we shouldn't ignore the errors, I'll use `MustRegister`. But the root of the bug here was calling the metrics creation function multiple times, when we should have been calling it once and passing a pointer to the metrics to each struct we created.

https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/7002#issuecomment-600643780 @bwplotka I thought we were avoiding using `promauto` in `prometheus/prometheus`?

> I thought we were avoiding using promauto in prometheus/prometheus?

`promauto` has learned a new trick. It can now deal with custom registries, too. @bwplotka is a great fan of it. I'm not against introducing it in Prometheus, but perhaps not in the context of a bug fix but as a separate step?
`promauto` is currently only used for two metrics, both in the remote storage package. I was planning to move those away from using `promauto` soon.

I guess that usage is still the "old" way of using `promauto` only with the global registry.

Wherever you create metrics just to `MustRegister` them directly after, you could as well use the new `promauto.With(registry).New...` pattern.
But as said, I don't think we should do any of those changes here in this PR.

Thanks for the reviews.

I think we're :+1: here now @roidelapluie, ready for another rc or 2.17.1 when you are. Let me know if you need any help.
